story.title: Older?
story.ctaText: How many did you get? Comment 👇

lines.q: Which is older, Big Ben's tower or the Eiffel Tower?
lines.a: Big Ben's tower! Finished thirty years before Eiffel's.
Nintendo! It started out selling playing cards in eighteen eighty nine.

lines.q: Harvard, or the United States itself?
lines.a: Harvard! A hundred and forty years older than the country.

lines.q: Last one. The Great Pyramid, or a tree that's still alive today?
lines.a: The tree! A bristlecone pine in California sprouted before the pyramid. Think you can get all four? Go again!
